name: Bases Descendant Filter
changes: Set Root formula to this.file to use the note that embeds a base as its root.
A base in the sidebar can follow the active note, with the same depth and Pro route explanations.
tip: Intermediate notes can stay outside the Bases query. The view still reads their parent links to connect the root to your notes.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Bases Descendant Filter is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for using it with Bases. Bases is still new, and your setups teach me a lot.
